text:
deploy-bot: Heads-up: starting soft-unpin for runtime v9.0 -> v9.1 in us-east-2 at 06:00 PT. Affected model-groups: summarizer-pro (fp16/quant hybrid), embedding-slim-q. Rollout: 5% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100% with 12m holds. Auto-pinback enabled. Playbook: https://go/redwood/ops/unpin-v9 :rocket:

anna: Note: v9.1 changes batching window heuristics (adaptive batching) which improved throughput but can increase tail latencies on short-lived / high-concurrency routes. We saw p99 spikes in lab for summarizer-pro at small batch sizes.

ryan: Also saw quantization-profile mismatch for embedding-slim-q when mixed fp16 fallback happens; causes repeated re-quant calls and backend thrash. Needs gating.

priya: SDK compatibility: sdk-4.0 clients ignore new `x-rw-priority` header; sdk-4.1 supports it. We have ~10 routes in us-east-2 still on sdk-4.0 (>120rps). Exclude or shadow them.

ops-runner: Ops checklist:
1) Start canary 5% in us-east-2
2) Exclude sdk-4.0 routes: `route.exclude_if sdk_version ~ "^4\\.0"` and shadow them for 20m
3) Probes: latency.p95, latency.p99, errors, host.mem, batching.window.p50, quant.requeue.count
4) Abort if p99 delta > 15% OR errors >0.5% OR quant.requeue.count > 50 in 10m
5) Rollback: `infractl rollback --runtime v9.1 --region us-east-2`
6) Pinback: `infractl pin --runtime v9.0 --model-group summarizer-pro`

csm-bot: Please post excluded route list to #private-csm for customer notice.

deploy-bot: Canary started 7590011230. Exclude and shadow applied. Telemetry hooks attached.

ops-runner: Canary update 7590011245: summarizer-pro p95 +6.2%, p99 +16.4% (hot), errors 0.09%, host.mem +60MB, batching.window.p50 decreased (more small batches), quant.requeue.count 3. embedding-slim-q stable but watch requeue.

anna: p99 > 15% threshold; this crosses abort condition. My recommendation: pause and attempt config tweak to batching.max_wait (reduce) and re-canary 5% on fresh host pool. If that fails, pinback summarizer-pro and continue for embedding-slim-q.

ryan: Agree. Tuning batching.max_wait may reduce p99 at some cost to throughput. Micro-config change quick (~15m) and no code build.

priya: I'll notify the SDK owners about the excluded routes and keep CSMs updated.

deploy-bot: Action: paused rollout at 7590011248 (pause id 7590011223). To abort run `deploy-bot pause 7590011223` or reply `abort` in thread.

ops-runner: Applying batching tweak now: `deploy-bot apply-config runtime.v9.1.batching.max_wait=6ms` on canary hosts. Will re-run 5% smoke after config settles.

csm-bot: Excluded route list posted. Draft customer note ready.

deploy-bot: Config change applied at 7590011255. Re-canary scheduled on fresh hosts at 7590011258. Reply `resume` to continue after checks or `abort` to cancel.

anna: Monitoring now 4a1 will report p95/p99 in 7m. If p99 drops below 12% delta, we proceed to 20%.

priya: Thanks all. If embed-slim-q shows quant requeue growth we may need a model-profiling pass before full unpin.

ops-runner: Standby for final go/no-go after re-canary window.
